scope: source-level candidate explanation, NOT measured profiling or causal attribution
findings: CLIP loader allocates default CPU buffer for all vision weights at clip.cpp:3642-3644; host tensors read directly into data at3659-3661.
CPU_REPACK backend requires a repack buffer and tensor traits; plain Q8 data is not automatically equivalent to repacked buffer.
repack.cpp:5111-5114 has Q8_0 4x4 ARM NEON+dotprod kernel, compatible shape multiple4; actual board feature dispatch must be checked.
Language loader explicitly enumerates extra buffers; visual loader does not.
